## Description

Tap/insert the EID: demographics (name EN/AR, DOB, nationality, expiry) fill in, duplicate check runs, exchange history is requested; staff confirm against the person. UAE PASS as an alternative for patient identity. Target < 30 s check-in.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Card-reader hardware model chosen and sourced (dependency 2) with a supported integration path (local agent or WebUSB).
- [ ] **AC2.** Median check-in with reader < 30 s in a timed test.
- [ ] **AC3.** Expired EID warns but does not block; data read is shown for confirmation before save.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
